title: REAPS efficiency review entering second phase
summary_en: The committee conducting the Iowa Board of Regents Revenue Enhancement and Productivity Study (REAPS) has identified nine areas for further exploration as the study enters its second phase.
title_cn: REAPS efficiency review entering second phase

title: College of Pharmacy ovarian cancer research moves to clinical trials
summary_en: A new approach to treating ovarian cancer has taken an important step forward. Research developed in the lab of Jill Kolesar, UI College of Pharmacy dean and Jean M. Schmidt Chair, has received FDA approval to move to clinical trials.
title_cn: College of Pharmacy ovarian cancer research moves to clinical trials

title: Iowa Veteran gets back in the game after targeted cancer treatment
summary_en: When Ron Watson’s prostate cancer persisted through several treatments, a targeted therapy available near his Ankeny home produced a remarkable response — and helped him return to the baseball field.
title_cn: Iowa Veteran gets back in the game after targeted cancer treatment
